page_title: LUT 1-2 MNU | Luton v Manchester Utd 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' David Coote is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The ball goes out for a corner. Luton can continue in their attacking effort.

90+4' Ross Barkley (Luton) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
90+3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) works the corner short.
90+2' The ball is out of play and Luton manage to earn a corner.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
87' Gabriel Osho (Luton) picks up a yellow card.
86' Corner kick. Luton will have an opportunity.
86' Erik ten Hag has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) replacing Rasmus Hojlund.
84' Neat passing move from Luton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
82' The game has come to an end for Alfie Doughty. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Luke Berry (Luton).
82' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andre Onana intercepts the ball.
81' Victor Lindelof (Manchester United) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
80' David Coote blows his whistle and it's Scott McTominay (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
75' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is punished with the yellow card.
75' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
72' Manchester Utd win a corner.
70' Andros Townsend (Luton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
68' Rob Edwards decides to make a substitution. Cauley Woodrow will be replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
68' It is time for a substitution. Jordan Clark (Luton) is on for Tahith Chong.
68' Lovely run from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
66' The referee signals a corner kick to Luton.
65' The current number of shots on goal is 4:7.

62' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) wins himself some space to meet the corner kick and unleashes a low shot from the edge of the box. His effort is directed to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
62' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

57' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
56' It will be a corner kick for Luton.
55' Alfie Doughty (Luton) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
52' An accurate cross picks out Tahith Chong (Luton) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
49' Luton are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Erik ten Hag gives a chance to Scott McTominay (Manchester United) and Casemiro is off.
46' The game is over for Harry Maguire (Manchester United). Jonny Evans comes on for the second half.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' That's the end of the game for Luke Shaw, who is replaced by Victor Lindelof (Manchester United).
45+2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Thomas Kaminski displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Luke Shaw (Manchester United) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
44' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Alfie Doughty (Luton).
42' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
40' A clumsy foul by Casemiro (Manchester United) and David Coote blows his whistle. Luton will take a free kick.

37' Carlton Morris (Luton) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Manchester Utd will have a goal kick.
36' 2:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
34' Casemiro (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Great teamplay by Luton as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Luton.

31' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Luton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' Looks like Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
29' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Luton.
26' 59:41 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
26' Manchester Utd force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Luton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
20' Luton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
14' 1 - 2 Carlton Morris (Luton) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball inside the left post, and thus alter the score to 1:2.
12' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

10' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
7' 0 - 2 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) receives the ball in the six-yard box and makes no mistake with the finish by burying it into the bottom left corner of the goal!
7' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
6' The resulting set piece from Manchester Utd is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

5' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Thomas Kaminski is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
4' Luke Shaw (Manchester United) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

1' 0 - 1 Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
